t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Make quick decisions and don't think too long about them. Stick to your strategy

vb_textbox.text: Don't think too hard about your decision. Try to decide early in the game how you want to play it. For example, 5 times left gnome, then 5 times right gnome. Or any other 'strategy' you want to use. Don't worry if you make what you think is the wrong decision. Just stay focused and make the most of the breaks to ensure that you don't get too tired.
